headline: Zipline Hires Uber Executive to Lead Distribution Center Expansion Across Africa
summary: US drone logistics startup Zipline appointed former Uber executive Anthony le Roux as Head of Operations for Africa to oversee the development of 20 new distribution centers for medical delivery.
why: Zipline operates automated drone delivery logistics, focusing on healthcare supply chain infrastructure in developing markets.

impacts.name: Zipline
impacts.why: Executive appointment signals capital deployment to expand logistics infrastructure across Africa.
